title: Successful login lands in admin shell with correct user and branch displayed
preconditions: App running. rootadmin user exists with known password. At least one active company and branch exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /login.
2. Enter username 'rootadmin' and its known password.
3. Click Sign In.
4. Wait for the admin shell to load.
expected: Redirect to /admin. Topbar shows the user's display name or initials. The active branch name appears in the branch selector. No raw uid is shown anywhere on screen.

title: Login with wrong password returns generic error — no user enumeration
preconditions: Known existing username (e.g. org.admin).
steps:
1. Navigate to /login.
2. Enter username 'org.admin' and password 'totally-wrong-1'.
3. Click Sign In.
expected: Stays on /login. Inline error message appears (generic 'Sign-in failed' or similar). No red modal dialog. POST /api/v1/auth/login returns 401. Error text is identical to the unknown-username case (IAM-003) — no user enumeration.

title: Login with unknown username returns the same generic error as wrong password
preconditions: None.
steps:
1. Navigate to /login.
2. Enter username 'does.not.exist' and password 'Whatever123'.
3. Click Sign In.
4. Compare the error text to IAM-002's error text.
expected: Stays on /login. Error text is word-for-word identical to the wrong-password error. 401 returned. No timing difference observable. No indication whether the username exists.

title: Account lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts; locked message appears
preconditions: A dedicated non-root test user (e.g. lockme.user) exists with a known correct password.
steps:
1. Navigate to /login.
2. Submit wrong password 5 times for 'lockme.user'.
3. On the 6th attempt submit the CORRECT password.
testData: username: lockme.user, wrong password: bad-pass-1 (×5), correct password: known value
expected: Attempts 1–4 return generic invalid-credentials message. Attempt 5 (threshold) and attempt 6 with correct password both return a distinct 'Account is locked. Try again later or contact an administrator.' message. Login is refused even with correct credentials while locked.

title: Disabled (INACTIVE) user cannot log in
preconditions: A user disabled via IAM-021 (status INACTIVE). Correct password is known.
steps:
1. Navigate to /login.
2. Enter the disabled user's username and correct password.
3. Click Sign In.
expected: Stays on /login. Generic invalid-credentials error shown. 401 returned. Reason for refusal not disclosed.

title: Token refresh rotates the refresh token (single-use); reuse triggers chain revocation
preconditions: A valid login session. Capture the refreshToken R1 from the login response.
steps:
1. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with R1 — capture new tokens (access2, R2).
2. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh again with R1 (the already-used token).
3. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with R2 (the valid new one).
testData: R1: captured refresh token from login
expected: Step 1: 200, new access and refresh tokens returned. Step 2: 401 'Refresh token already used. Please sign in again.' (chain revoked). Step 3: also 401 — the whole chain is revoked upon reuse detection.

title: Logout revokes the refresh token and clears the session
preconditions: An active logged-in session.
steps:
1. Log in as any user.
2. Open the user menu in the topbar; click Logout.
3. Attempt to navigate to /admin.
4. After logout, replay the revoked refresh token via POST /api/v1/auth/refresh.
expected: POST /api/v1/auth/logout returns 204. Browser redirects to /login. Navigating to /admin again redirects back to /login. Replaying the revoked refresh token returns 401.

title: Expired/invalid access token triggers session-expired toast and redirect to login
preconditions: A logged-in session.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Corrupt or manually expire the stored access token (tamper localStorage).
3. Navigate to /admin/users to trigger an API call.
expected: The API returns 401. The auth error interceptor clears the session, shows a toast 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.', and redirects to /login. No infinite redirect loop.

title: Login client-side guard: blank username/password prevents form submission
preconditions: None.
steps:
1. Navigate to /login.
2. Leave both username and password blank.
3. Click Sign In.
expected: Inline validation error appears ('Enter your username and password.' or similar). No POST /api/v1/auth/login is issued. Whitespace-only username is treated as empty.

title: GET /auth/me drives permission-aware navigation (items hidden for missing permissions)
preconditions: Three users: NO-PERMISSION user (no roles), a CUSTOM-role user (COMPANY.VIEW + USER.VIEW only), ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Log in as the NO-PERMISSION user; inspect the sidebar items.
2. Log out; log in as the CUSTOM-role user; inspect the sidebar.
3. Log out; log in as ORG_ADMIN; inspect the sidebar.
expected: NO-PERMISSION: no permission-gated nav items visible. CUSTOM: only Companies and Users nav items appear. ORG_ADMIN: all Administration items visible. GET /api/v1/auth/me returns the corresponding permissions[] array for each.

title: GET /auth/my-branches lists only ACTIVE switchable branches for the user
preconditions: A user assigned to at least 2 ACTIVE branches and 1 ARCHIVED/inactive branch.
steps:
1. Log in as that user.
2. Open the topbar branch selector.
testData: User with branches: HQ (ACTIVE), Mwanza (ACTIVE), Old Branch (ARCHIVED)
expected: Only the two ACTIVE branches appear in the selector. The archived branch is not listed. Branches are shown by name, not by uid. The current active branch is highlighted.

title: Branch switch re-resolves permissions and sends X-Branch-Uid header
preconditions: A user assigned to Branch A (default) and Branch B, with different effective grants per branch.
steps:
1. Log in (lands on Branch A). Note the nav items.
2. Open the branch selector; pick Branch B by name.
3. Observe the nav items and confirm subsequent API calls carry X-Branch-Uid: <B-uid>.
testData: Branch A: HQ (default), Branch B: Mwanza Depot
expected: After switching to Branch B, GET /api/v1/auth/me is called with X-Branch-Uid header set to Branch B's uid. Nav recomputes to reflect Branch B's effective permissions. No re-login required. Branch is selected by name — uid only goes in the header.

title: Create a user with valid data
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds USER.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users.
2. Fill the create form: username, display name, password.
3. Submit.
testData: username: new.clerk, displayName: New Clerk, password: Welcome123
expected: POST /api/v1/users returns 201. New row appears in the table showing username and display name (no uid visible). Toast 'User created'. is_root is false. User status is ACTIVE.

title: Create user: duplicate username rejected (case-insensitive)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Existing username 'org.admin' is present.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users.
2. Submit create form with username 'ORG.ADMIN' (different case).
expected: 409 returned. Inline form error 'Username already exists: org.admin'. No new row added.

title: Create user: password too short (< 8 chars) rejected
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users.
2. Submit create form with password 'Ab1' (3 chars).
expected: 400 or 409 with error 'Password must be at least 8 characters.' Inline error shown. User not created. Boundary: exactly 8 chars passes; 7 chars fails.

title: Create user: common password rejected; no-letter and no-digit passwords rejected
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Attempt (a) password 'abcdefgh' (no digit). 2. Attempt (b) password 'password1' (common list). 3. Attempt (c) password '12345678' (no letter + common). 4. Attempt (d) password 'Welcome123' (valid).
expected: (a) 'Password must contain letters and at least one number.' (b) 'Password is too common; choose a stronger one.' (c) rejected (no letter and common). (d) user created successfully. Each common-list entry (password, password1, 12345678, qwerty123, admin123, letmein123, changeme, welcome1, passw0rd) is rejected.

title: Disable an active user (status → INACTIVE)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. An ACTIVE non-root user exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users.
2. On the target row, click Disable.
3. Reload the page.
expected: PUT /api/v1/users/uid/{uid}/disable returns 204. On reload GET /api/v1/users shows the user with status 'INACTIVE'. Disable action is NOT rendered for root users.

title: Enable a disabled user (status → ACTIVE); re-login then succeeds
preconditions: An INACTIVE user (from IAM-017).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users.
2. On the disabled row, click Enable.
3. Log out; log in as the re-enabled user.
expected: PUT /api/v1/users/uid/{uid}/enable returns 204. Status returns to ACTIVE on reload. The user can log in again.

title: Admin unlock clears lockout; login then succeeds
preconditions: A locked user (from IAM-004).
steps:
1. Log in as ORG_ADMIN; navigate to /admin/users.
2. Locate the locked user; click Unlock.
3. Log out; log in as the unlocked user with the correct password.
expected: PUT /api/v1/users/uid/{uid}/unlock returns 204. User row no longer shows locked status. Subsequent login with correct password succeeds.

title: Admin password reset; user can log in with new password
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A non-root user exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users.
2. Expand the set-password form for the target user.
3. Enter a policy-valid password; save.
4. Log out; log in as that user with the new password.
expected: PUT /api/v1/users/uid/{uid}/password returns 204. Toast 'Password updated'. Password never appears in a log or audit detail. Login with the new password succeeds.

title: Viewer-only user (USER.VIEW, no USER.MANAGE) cannot perform management actions
preconditions: A user holding USER.VIEW but NOT USER.MANAGE.
steps:
1. Log in as the view-only user.
2. Navigate to /admin/users (list loads).
3. Attempt to click Disable, Unlock, or the set-password form.
4. Force POST /api/v1/users directly.
expected: List renders. Management actions (Disable, Enable, Unlock, Set Password, Create) are hidden. Forced POST returns 403. No red modal — 403 is handled as a calm state.

title: No-permission user cannot reach /admin/users; route guard redirects to /admin/home
preconditions: A user with no roles/permissions (qa.noperm).
steps:
1. Log in as qa.noperm.
2. Navigate directly to /admin/users.
expected: Route guard redirects to /admin/home. The Users nav item is absent from the sidebar. GET /api/v1/users returns 403.

title: User detail: uid only in URL, never displayed; branch/role panels use name pickers
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A user exists.
steps:
1. From /admin/users, click the row action to open /admin/users/uid/:uid.
2. Inspect the page header, branch-assignment panel, and role-grant panel.
3. Scan all visible text for uid strings.
expected: Header shows username/display name/status — no uid text. The uid appears only in the URL path. Branch and role pickers select by name from dropdowns. No raw uid is typed or shown in any label or cell.

title: Create a role with org-unique code
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds ROLE.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/roles.
2. Fill create form: code, name, optional description.
3. Submit.
testData: code: BRANCH_SUP, name: Branch Supervisor, description: Reviews branch ops
expected: POST /api/v1/roles returns 201. New row appears. Role is non-system (system: false), status ACTIVE, empty permissionCodes. Row links to /admin/roles/uid/:uid — uid only in URL.

title: Create role: duplicate code rejected
preconditions: Role with code BRANCH_SUP already exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/roles.
2. Submit create form with code 'BRANCH_SUP'.
expected: 409 returned. Inline error 'Role code already exists: BRANCH_SUP'. No row added.

title: Set role permissions via grouped checkbox UI (replace semantics)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds ROLE.MANAGE + PERMISSION.VIEW). A custom role exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/roles/uid/:uid for the custom role.
2. Check USER.VIEW and USER.MANAGE; uncheck all others.
3. Save permissions.
testData: Role: BRANCH_SUP; permissions to set: USER.VIEW, USER.MANAGE
expected: PUT /api/v1/roles/uid/{uid}/permissions returns 200 RoleDto with sorted permissionCodes [USER.MANAGE, USER.VIEW]. Checkbox state reflects the saved set. Saving an empty list is valid (clears all permissions).

title: Archive a non-system role; system role archive blocked
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A custom non-system role and a seeded system role (e.g. ORG_ADMIN) both exist.
steps:
1. Archive the custom role BRANCH_SUP.
2. Attempt to archive the system role ORG_ADMIN.
testData: Custom role: BRANCH_SUP, System role: ORG_ADMIN
expected: Custom role: 204, status ARCHIVED (soft-delete, row still exists). System role attempt: 409 'System role cannot be archived: ORG_ADMIN'. Cache invalidated after archive.

title: ROLE.VIEW-only user cannot create or edit roles; edit route redirects to home
preconditions: A user holding ROLE.VIEW but NOT ROLE.MANAGE.
steps:
1. Log in as the ROLE.VIEW-only user.
2. Navigate to /admin/roles (list loads).
3. Navigate directly to /admin/roles/uid/:uid (the edit screen).
expected: List loads. Create form/button is hidden. Direct navigation to the edit route redirects to /admin/home. PUT /api/v1/roles/uid/{uid}/permissions returns 403.

title: Grant a company-wide role to a user via pickers (no uid typed)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds ROLE.MANAGE). Target user and role exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/role-grants.
2. Choose user by display name (picker), role by name, company by name; leave branch blank.
3. Click Grant.
testData: user: New Clerk, role: Branch Supervisor, company: (active company name)
expected: POST /api/v1/user-roles returns 201 UserRoleDto with branchUid: null. Toast 'Role granted'. Grant appears when the user's grants are listed. No uid typed or shown during the process.

title: Grant role scoped to a specific branch (branch picker loads on company selection)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Multi-branch company exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/role-grants.
2. Pick user, role, company; after company selection the branch picker reloads.
3. Pick a branch by name; click Grant.
testData: user: New Clerk, role: Branch Supervisor, branch: Mwanza Depot
expected: 201 with branchUid set to the chosen branch. Grant is effective only in that branch context. Branch selected by name — uid stored under the hood.

title: Duplicate active grant rejected (same user/role/company/branch combination)
preconditions: An existing active grant for a user+role+company+branch combination.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/role-grants.
2. Attempt to re-grant the exact same combination.
testData: Same user, role, company, branch as an existing active grant
expected: 409 'Active grant already exists for this user/role/company/branch combination.' Inline form error. No duplicate row created.

title: Revoke a role grant; grantee's effective permissions drop
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A grant exists for a target user.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/role-grants; look up grants for the target user.
2. On a grant row, click Revoke.
3. Have the target user call GET /api/v1/customers to verify permission loss.
testData: Target user with an active grant
expected: DELETE /api/v1/user-roles/uid/{uid} returns 204. Row removed from list on reload. Target user immediately loses the revoked permissions (cache invalidated). Their subsequent API call returns 403.

title: Cross-tenant role grant denied (ScopeGuard): acting in Company A cannot grant in Company B
preconditions: Two companies A and B. Non-root ORG_ADMIN scoped to Company A. Company B has a grant to revoke.
steps:
1. Log in as Company A's admin (active company = A).
2. POST /api/v1/user-roles with companyUid = Company B.
3. DELETE a Company-B grant uid.
expected: Both calls return 403. ScopeGuard.assertCanActIn denies cross-company action. rootadmin performing the same action succeeds and emits a ROOT.BYPASS audit row.

title: Assign a user to a branch (non-default) via the user-detail panel
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds BRANCH.ASSIGN). A user with no branch assignment and a company with branches exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users/uid/:uid.
2. In the Branch panel: pick company by name, then pick branch by name; leave make-default unchecked.
3. Click Assign.
expected: POST /api/v1/user-branches returns 201. Branch appears in the user's assignments by name. No uid typed or shown.

title: Assign branch with make-default=true clears the prior default (one-default invariant)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. User already has Branch X as default.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users/uid/:uid.
2. Assign Branch Y with make-default checked.
expected: 201 returned. Branch Y becomes the single default. Branch X's default flag is cleared. Only one row shows 'Default'. The DB partial unique index enforces at most one default.

title: Set an existing assignment as the new default
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. User has multiple branch assignments.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users/uid/:uid.
2. On a non-default assignment row, click Set default.
expected: PUT /api/v1/user-branches/uid/{uid}/default returns 200. Mwanza becomes Default. HQ loses its Default flag. Exactly one Default at all times.

title: Remove a branch assignment; default auto-falls back to earliest remaining assignment
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. User has Branch X (default), Branch Y and Z.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/users/uid/:uid.
2. Remove Branch X (the current default).
testData: User with 3 branches; X is default
expected: DELETE /api/v1/user-branches/uid/{uid} returns 204. Branch X removed. The earliest-assigned remaining branch (Y or Z) becomes the new default. If removing the last branch the user has no default on next login (hasBranch: false).

title: Branch assignment list requires USER.VIEW; assign/set-default/remove require BRANCH.ASSIGN
preconditions: Two users: one with USER.VIEW only, one with BRANCH.ASSIGN only.
steps:
1. Log in as USER.VIEW-only user; open /admin/users/uid/:uid — branch list loads.
2. Attempt Assign, Set default, Remove actions.
3. Log out; log in as BRANCH.ASSIGN-only user (lacks USER.VIEW); attempt to open the page.
expected: USER.VIEW-only: list loads; management actions hidden/return 403. BRANCH.ASSIGN-only without USER.VIEW: page guarded away (or sub-list returns 403 on GET /user-branches).

title: Cross-tenant branch assign denied; acting in unassigned branch via forged X-Branch-Uid denied
preconditions: Non-root BRANCH.ASSIGN admin active in Company A. A Company B branch exists.
steps:
1. POST /api/v1/user-branches with a Company-B branchUid.
2. Send a request with X-Branch-Uid set to a branch NOT in the user's my-branches.
expected: Step 1: 403 via @perm.scoped scope check. Step 2: 403 — the filter rejects the override. The branch selector never offers out-of-scope branches to this user.

title: Create a company under the organisation
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds COMPANY.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/companies.
2. Fill create form: code and name (org resolved automatically).
3. Submit.
testData: code: C2, name: Second Co Ltd
expected: POST /api/v1/companies returns 201 CompanyDto (status ACTIVE). Row appears. organisationUid taken from the resolved org — never typed. Duplicate code within the org returns 409.

title: Create a branch under a company; first branch becomes default automatically
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds BRANCH.MANAGE). A company exists.
steps:
1. From /admin/companies, click the company to open /admin/companies/:companyUid/branches.
2. Fill create form: code, name; leave make-default unchecked.
3. Submit.
expected: POST /api/v1/branches returns 201 BranchDto (status ACTIVE). List reloads. companyUid comes from the route — not typed. Duplicate branch code within company returns 409.

title: Set a branch as company default (clears previous default; one-default-per-company)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Multi-branch company exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/companies/:companyUid/branches.
2. On a non-default branch, click Set default.
expected: PUT /api/v1/branches/uid/{uid}/default returns 200. Mwanza becomes default; previous default is cleared. Exactly one Default flag in the list.

title: Archive a branch (soft-delete); archived branch disappears from my-branches switcher
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A non-default branch exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/companies/:companyUid/branches.
2. Archive a non-default branch.
3. Log in as a user assigned to that branch and open the branch switcher.
expected: DELETE /api/v1/branches/uid/{uid} returns 204. Branch status → ARCHIVED (not removed). Archived branch no longer appears in the branch switcher (my-branches) for any user.

title: Cross-tenant company/branch access denied for non-root admin
preconditions: Non-root ORG_ADMIN active in Company A. Company B's uid is known.
steps:
1. GET /api/v1/companies/uid/{B-uid} as Company A admin.
2. GET /api/v1/branches?companyUid={B-uid} as Company A admin.
testData: Company B uid, Company B branch uid
expected: Both return 403 (@perm.scoped enforces active-company scope). Company B data never appears in Company A admin's lists. rootadmin can access both companies.

title: COMPANY.VIEW-only user cannot create/edit/archive companies
preconditions: A user holding COMPANY.VIEW but NOT COMPANY.MANAGE.
steps:
1. Log in as the view-only user.
2. Navigate to /admin/companies (list loads).
3. Attempt to use the create form or any edit/archive action.
expected: List renders. Create form and edit/archive actions are hidden. Forced POST /api/v1/companies returns 403.

title: rootadmin bypass: can perform every IAM action across all companies; ROOT.BYPASS audit row written
preconditions: rootadmin. Two companies A and B. AUDIT.VIEW to inspect the audit log.
steps:
1. Log in as rootadmin (active company = A).
2. Perform an action on Company B's resource (e.g. edit Company B or a Company B branch).
3. Open /admin/audit and filter by action ROOT.BYPASS.
expected: The cross-company action succeeds. A ROOT.BYPASS audit row exists with target_type 'companies' and the acting/target company ids. Actions within the active company do NOT produce a ROOT.BYPASS row.

title: rootadmin cannot be disabled via the API (409 safeguard)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN with USER.MANAGE.
steps: 1. Call PUT /api/v1/users/uid/{rootadmin-uid}/disable directly.
expected: 409 'A root administrator cannot be disabled via the API.' No status change. The Disable action is not rendered for root users in the UI.

title: /auth/me returns correct effective permission set per role
preconditions: Operational role bundles seeded for: ORG_ADMIN, SALES_MANAGER, SALES_REP, ACCOUNTANT, STOREKEEPER, PURCHASE_OFFICER, CUSTOM (CUSTOMER.VIEW+PRODUCT.VIEW only), NO-PERM.
steps:
1. Log in as each test user in turn.
2. Call GET /api/v1/auth/me and capture permissions[].
testData: Users: qa.orgadmin, qa.salesmgr, qa.salesrep, qa.accountant, qa.storekeeper, qa.purchaser, qa.custom, qa.noperm
expected: ORG_ADMIN: superset covering all modules. Each operational user: set equals its intended bundle. qa.noperm: permissions: []. rootadmin: isRoot: true. Any divergence from the design matrix is logged as a finding.

title: ORG_ADMIN can administer companies, users, and roles
preconditions: qa.orgadmin logged in.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/companies, /admin/users, /admin/roles.
2. Confirm all three nav items are visible.
3. Open a create form on each.
expected: All three screens load (four states: loading → loaded). Create forms are reachable. POST on each returns 201. No uid shown in any cell or label.

title: SALES_MANAGER can create/confirm sales orders; cannot access GL or IAM-admin
preconditions: qa.salesmgr logged in. At least one customer and product seeded.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/sales-orders; create an order (pick customer + product by name).
2. Confirm the order.
3. Navigate directly to /admin/gl/journals.
4. Navigate directly to /admin/users.
5. Call GET /api/v1/gl/journals and GET /api/v1/users directly.
testData: Customer: Acme Traders, product: Sugar 1kg, qty: 5
expected: Create and Confirm succeed. /admin/gl/journals and /admin/users redirect to /admin/home. GL and Users nav items are absent. Both direct API calls return 403 with the generic message.

title: SALES_REP can create sales orders but NOT confirm or cancel them
preconditions: qa.salesrep logged in. A DRAFT sales order exists created by the rep.
steps:
1. Create a sales order (succeeds).
2. Look for Confirm and Cancel controls on the order detail.
3. Call PUT /api/v1/sales-orders/uid/{uid}/confirm directly.
expected: Create returns 201. Confirm and Cancel buttons are NOT rendered (action-level gating). Direct confirm API returns 403.

title: ACCOUNTANT can post GL, record AR receipts, run AP payments; cannot create sales or manage users
preconditions: qa.accountant logged in. Open fiscal period; an AR invoice and AP bill exist.
steps:
1. Post a balanced journal (pick accounts by name).
2. Record an AR receipt.
3. Run an AP payment.
4. Navigate to /admin/sales-orders/create and /admin/users directly.
5. POST /api/v1/sales-orders directly.
expected: Steps 1-3 succeed. Steps 4-5: sales-create and users redirect to home / nav hidden. POST /api/v1/sales-orders returns 403.

title: STOREKEEPER can adjust stock and create/receive stock transfers; cannot access GL or sales
preconditions: qa.storekeeper logged in. At least one product and two stock locations exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/stock; adjust on-hand (pick product by name).
2. Navigate to /admin/stock-transfers; create a transfer (pick locations by name); receive it.
3. Navigate directly to /admin/gl/journals and /admin/sales-orders.
4. GET /api/v1/gl/journals directly.
expected: Steps 1-2 succeed. Steps 3-4: GL and sales redirect to home / nav hidden; direct API returns 403.

title: PURCHASE_OFFICER can create POs; cannot approve or void them
preconditions: qa.purchaser logged in. At least one supplier exists.
steps:
1. Create a PO (pick supplier by name).
2. Look for Approve and Void controls on the PO detail.
3. Call POST /api/v1/purchase-orders/uid/{uid}/approve directly.
expected: Create returns 201. Approve and Void controls not rendered (action-level gating). Direct approve returns 403. Segregation of duties enforced by permission code, not ownership.

title: CUSTOM role (CUSTOMER.VIEW + PRODUCT.VIEW) sees only those two screens; all else hidden/403
preconditions: qa.custom user assigned the CUSTOM role (exactly CUSTOMER.VIEW + PRODUCT.VIEW).
steps:
1. Log in as qa.custom.
2. Inspect the sidebar items.
3. Navigate to /admin/customers and /admin/products (load).
4. Navigate to /admin/suppliers, /admin/sales-orders, /admin/gl/journals directly.
5. POST /api/v1/customers and GET /api/v1/suppliers directly.
expected: Sidebar shows only Customers and Products (no Create button — lacks MANAGE codes). Other routes redirect to /admin/home. POST /api/v1/customers returns 403. GET /api/v1/suppliers returns 403.

title: NO-PERM user: empty nav, every protected screen redirects, every API returns 403
preconditions: qa.noperm user has no role grant.
steps:
1. Log in as qa.noperm.
2. Inspect the sidebar.
3. Navigate directly to /admin/customers, /admin/users, /admin/gl/journals.
4. Call GET /api/v1/customers and GET /api/v1/users.
expected: Sidebar shows no permission-gated items. Every protected route redirects to /admin/home. All protected API calls return 403 with the generic message. GET /api/v1/auth/me returns permissions: []. GET /auth/my-branches still succeeds (authentication, not authorization).

title: Cross-tenant denial: ORG_ADMIN of Tenant A cannot touch Tenant B's customer
preconditions: Two tenants A and B, each with a customer. Company A's qa.orgadmin is granted ORG_ADMIN in Company A only.
steps:
1. Log in as Company A admin (active company = A).
2. Obtain Company B customer uid out-of-band.
3. Call PUT /api/v1/customers/uid/{B_customer_uid}.
4. Call GET /api/v1/customers/uid/{B_customer_uid}.
expected: Both calls return 403. ScopeGuard.canActOn detects target's company = B ≠ active A. Company B's customer never appears in Company A's list. An unresolvable uid also returns 403 (not 404 — avoids existence leak).

title: @perm.scoped on body companyUid: create denied when companyUid != active company
preconditions: Two companies A and B. User holds SALES.ORDER.CREATE scoped to Company A.
steps:
1. Log in (active company A).
2. POST /api/v1/sales-orders with companyUid = Company B.
3. POST /api/v1/gl/journals with companyUid = Company B.
expected: Both return 403 (body-scoped guard: holds perm but B != active A). Same calls with companyUid = A succeed (201), proving the gate is scope not the permission itself.

title: Branch-scoped grant: user with role only in Branch 1 is denied STOCK.VIEW in Branch 2
preconditions: Company A with branch1 (default) and branch2. User granted STOCK.VIEW/STOCK.ADJUST scoped to branch1 only.
steps:
1. Log in (default branch1). View stock → 200.
2. Switch active branch to branch2 (branch selector by name).
3. Call GET /api/v1/stock.
testData: branch1, branch2; STOCK.VIEW grant on branch1 only
expected: branch1: stock loads. After switching to branch2: GET /api/v1/stock returns 403 (no grant in branch2). Nav reflects loss of STOCK.VIEW. Switch back to branch1 restores access — all without re-login.

title: Company-wide grant (branch_id NULL) works in all branches of the same company
preconditions: Company A with branch1 and branch2. User has STOCK.VIEW granted with branch_id = NULL (all branches).
steps:
1. Log in (branch1). View stock → 200.
2. Switch to branch2. View stock → expect 200.
expected: Stock loads in both branches (NULL branch_id = effective company-wide). Data differs per branch (branch-scoped rows) but the permission holds in both. Switching to a different company branch fails (cross-tenant).

title: Acting in an unassigned branch via forged X-Branch-Uid is denied
preconditions: User assigned (UserBranch) to branch1 only. Branch2 exists in the same company.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Confirm branch2 is NOT in the branch selector (only branch1 listed).
3. Send an API call with X-Branch-Uid: branch2.
expected: Branch selector shows only branch1. Forged override to branch2 is rejected by the filter (no effective scope there) → 403. The UI cannot reach branch2 at all for this user.

title: Effective permissions update promptly after grant/revoke (cache invalidated)
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN and a target user holding a role with CUSTOMER.VIEW.
steps:
1. As ORG_ADMIN, revoke the target's role (DELETE /api/v1/user-roles/uid/{uid}).
2. Immediately, as the target, call GET /api/v1/customers.
3. Re-grant and retry.
expected: After revoke: GET /api/v1/customers returns 403 promptly (cache invalidated by invalidate()). After re-grant: 200 returned. GET /api/v1/auth/me reflects the change in the permissions array.

title: 401 vs 403 response contract; error message never names the required permission
preconditions: A protected endpoint accessible by ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Call the endpoint with no bearer token.
2. Call the same endpoint with a valid token from qa.noperm (insufficient permission).
expected: Step 1: 401, body ApiResponse.error('Authentication is required.'). Step 2: 403, body ApiResponse.error('You do not have permission to perform this action.'). Neither message names the required permission code, the resource, or whether it exists.

title: Nav-hidden / route-guarded / API-gated are consistent for the same permission code
preconditions: A user lacking COMPANY.VIEW.
steps:
1. Confirm the Companies nav item is absent from the sidebar.
2. Navigate directly to /admin/companies — confirm redirect to /admin/home.
3. Call GET /api/v1/companies — confirm 403.
expected: All three enforcement points (nav, route guard, API) agree: no Companies access. The same test repeated for STOCK.VIEW (stock), SALES.ORDER.VIEW (sales-orders), GL.VIEW (gl/journals), PURCHASE.ORDER.VIEW (purchase-orders). Any mismatch is a finding.

title: POS session/sale/till: non-root users (including ORG_ADMIN) receive 403 — known defect
preconditions: qa.orgadmin (holds SALES.POS.* codes from V43 seed). A POS till exists.
steps:
1. Log in as qa.orgadmin.
2. Navigate to /admin/pos/sessions; attempt to open a session.
3. Navigate to /admin/pos/sell; attempt to ring a sale.
4. Navigate to /admin/pos/tills; attempt to list/create.
5. Call POST /api/v1/pos/sessions, POST /api/v1/pos/sales, GET /api/v1/pos/tills directly.
expected: EXPECTED FAILURE (known defect): All non-root users get 403 on POS endpoints. Controllers require POS.SESSION.*/POS.SALE.CREATE/POS.TILL.* codes; the seeded catalogue defines SALES.POS.* codes — these do not match. POS nav items are hidden for non-root. Only rootadmin (bypass) can operate POS. Record the defect; do not mark as a pass.

title: GL.YEAR.CLOSE restricted to ORG_ADMIN; ACCOUNTANT is denied
preconditions: qa.orgadmin and qa.accountant. A fiscal year eligible to close exists.
steps:
1. As ORG_ADMIN: open the year-end close screen; run the close.
2. As ACCOUNTANT: navigate to the year-end close route; attempt the same via API.
expected: ORG_ADMIN: close succeeds. ACCOUNTANT: nav hidden, route redirects to home, API returns 403. Closing an already-closed year returns a business 4xx (distinct from 403).

title: NOTIFICATION.ADMIN restricted to ORG_ADMIN; all operational roles get NOTIFICATION.VIEW
preconditions: qa.salesmgr (holds NOTIFICATION.VIEW) and qa.orgadmin (holds NOTIFICATION.ADMIN).
steps:
1. As qa.salesmgr: view notifications and manage own preferences (succeed). Attempt the admin type-catalogue endpoint.
2. As qa.orgadmin: open the admin type catalogue (succeeds).
expected: Operational user: view/preferences OK; admin catalogue endpoint returns 403. ORG_ADMIN: all notifications endpoints succeed. qa.noperm: even NOTIFICATION.VIEW returns 403.

title: Generated documents log lists for the active company
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds DOCUMENT.VIEW). At least one rendered document exists for the company.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/documents.
2. Observe the list loads with columns: document number, type badge, source reference, generated-at, download action.
expected: GET /api/v1/documents returns 200 ApiResponse<List> + meta (page, size, totalElements, totalPages, hasNext). Table renders rows. No raw uid shown in any column. Paginator present and self-hides when only one page.

title: Documents log: four screen states (loading / empty / error / forbidden)
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN for normal states; NO-PERMISSION user for forbidden state.
steps:
1. Throttle the list response to observe the loading spinner.
2. Switch to a company with no documents to observe the empty state.
3. Force a network error to observe the error state.
4. Log in as NO-PERMISSION user and navigate to /admin/documents.
expected: Each state is visually distinct: loading spinner, explicit 'no documents' message, error panel with retry, forbidden message. Never a silent blank page. NO-PERMISSION: Documents nav group hidden; 403 on direct API call.

title: Filter documents log by DocumentType
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Documents of mixed types exist.
steps:
1. On /admin/documents choose 'Invoice' in the Type filter.
2. Assert only INVOICE rows show.
3. Switch to 'AR Statement' → only AR_STATEMENT rows.
4. Switch to 'All types' → full list.
expected: Server-side filter applied (request carries type=INVOICE). Page resets to 0 on filter change. Badge per type. Reserved types (PAYSLIP, QUOTATION, DEBIT_NOTE) are not offered in the filter select. Filter with no matches → empty state.

title: Render an INVOICE document — source chosen via picker by invoice number
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds DOCUMENT.RENDER). A finalised sales invoice exists.
steps:
1. On /admin/documents, click 'Render document'; choose Type = Invoice.
2. In the source picker select the invoice BY its invoice number (not uid).
3. Submit; observe toast and new log row.
expected: POST /api/v1/documents/render returns 200 GeneratedDocumentDto with downloadUrl. New row appears at top of log showing INVOICE badge. No uid typed or shown during the process. DOCUMENT.VIEW-only user cannot see the render button.

title: Render each renderable DocumentType: PURCHASE_ORDER, GOODS_RECEIPT, DELIVERY_NOTE, CREDIT_NOTE
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Source records exist for each type.
steps: For each type (PURCHASE_ORDER, GOODS_RECEIPT, DELIVERY_NOTE, CREDIT_NOTE): 1. Open render form. 2. Select type; pick source by its human number. 3. Submit.
expected: Each render succeeds (200). Correct documentType badge on the new row. Correct source linkage. Source picker for each type shows only records of that type.

title: Render an AR_STATEMENT with JSON sourceParams (customer chosen by name)
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (holds DOCUMENT.RENDER). A customer with open AR items exists.
steps:
1. Open render form; choose Type = AR Statement.
2. The form switches to JSON params input; enter customer (chosen by name via picker) and date range.
3. Submit.
expected: Statement renders; row shows AR_STATEMENT badge; 200 returned. AR_STATEMENT submitted with empty params returns inline validation error. Non-statement type with no source uid also fails inline.

title: Render a reserved DocumentType (PAYSLIP) is rejected by the server
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. Call POST /api/v1/documents/render with documentType=PAYSLIP (not selectable in UI).
expected: Request rejected with error envelope (4xx). No log row created. The UI does not offer PAYSLIP/QUOTATION/DEBIT_NOTE in the type select — server enforcement is the backstop.

title: Download a generated PDF (requires DOCUMENT.RENDER; DOCUMENT.VIEW-only is denied)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A generated-document row exists.
steps:
1. On /admin/documents, click the row's Download action.
2. Assert a PDF blob downloads.
expected: GET /api/v1/documents/uid/{uid}/download returns 200 application/pdf, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename='invoice-INV-2026-0007.pdf'. DOCUMENT.VIEW-only user: download returns 403. Cross-tenant uid: 403.

title: Template registry lists + toggle a template status (DOCUMENT.TEMPLATE.MANAGE)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Seeded template registry rows exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/document-templates; list loads (full array, not paginated).
2. On the INVOICE row, change status to INACTIVE and edit the title.
3. Save; reload to verify change persisted.
testData: Template: INVOICE / TRANSACTIONAL_PDF; title: Tax Invoice
expected: GET /api/v1/documents/templates returns the template array. PUT /api/v1/documents/templates/{uid} returns 200 with updated DocumentTemplateDto. Status reflected. User without DOCUMENT.TEMPLATE.MANAGE → 403 on PUT and nav item hidden.

title: Edit the company branding profile (singleton — no uid in URL)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds DOCUMENT.BRANDING.MANAGE).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/document-branding; the singleton profile loads into an edit form.
2. Edit display name, legal name, tax id, contact email.
3. Save; reload to verify values persisted.
testData: displayName: Acme Trading, legalName: Acme Trading Ltd, taxId: TIN-123456789, contactEmail: ar@acme.test
expected: PUT /api/v1/documents/branding returns 200 DocumentBrandingDto with updatedAt advanced. Changes persist on reload. Stale version returns conflict error. User without permission → 403; nav item hidden.

title: Updated branding is reflected in a freshly rendered document (visual check)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. An invoice source exists.
steps:
1. Change the branding display name.
2. Render a new INVOICE.
3. Download and open the PDF.
testData: New display name: Updated Co Name
expected: The rendered PDF header shows the updated branding display name. Previously generated documents are unchanged (append-only log). This is a visual/manual verification.

title: In-app inbox lists the caller's notifications scoped to active company
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (holds NOTIFICATION.VIEW). Notifications addressed to this user exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/notifications.
2. Read rows: title, body, severity badge (INFO/WARNING/CRITICAL), created-at.
testData: ACCOUNTANT user with at least 3 notifications
expected: GET /api/v1/notifications returns 200 + meta. Only this user's company notifications shown. Severity badges are visually distinct. Paginator present. NO-PERMISSION user: forbidden.

title: Inbox unread filter and shell unread-count badge
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT. Mix of read and unread notifications exist.
steps:
1. Toggle 'Unread only' filter on — only unread rows show; request carries unread=true.
2. Read the shell unread-count badge; cross-check against GET /api/v1/notifications/unread-count.
expected: Filtered list shows only unread. Badge value equals UnreadCountDto.count. With zero unread: filter shows empty state; badge shows 0 or is hidden. Page resets to 0 on filter toggle.

title: Mark a single notification read; marking another user's notification is denied
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT. An unread notification exists for this user. Another user's notification uid is known.
steps:
1. On /admin/notifications, click 'Mark read' on an unread row.
2. Assert the row flips to read and unread count decrements.
3. Attempt POST /api/v1/notifications/uid/{other-user-uid}/read.
testData: Own unread notification; another user's notification uid
expected: POST /api/v1/notifications/uid/{uid}/read returns 204. Row marked read; readAt set on next fetch. Another user's notification: 403 (recipient-is-me enforced by service, BR-NOTIF-04). Already-read row: no-op.

title: Mark all notifications read clears the unread count
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT. Several unread notifications exist.
steps:
1. Click 'Mark all read'.
2. Observe toast.
3. Reload — unread count is 0.
expected: POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all returns 204. All caller notifications marked read. Badge cleared. With no unread: no-op success.

title: Per-user notification preferences: list and upsert a preference (NOTIFICATION.PREFERENCE.MANAGE)
preconditions: Logged in as ACCOUNTANT (holds NOTIFICATION.PREFERENCE.MANAGE). Type catalogue seeded.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/notification-preferences; preferences load (plain array).
2. For typeKey LOW_STOCK, toggle muted=true and set channelsEnabled=IN_APP.
3. Save; reload to verify.
testData: typeKey: LOW_STOCK, muted: true, channelsEnabled: IN_APP
expected: PUT /api/v1/notification-preferences/{typeKey} returns 200 NotificationPreferenceDto. Preference persisted per-user scope. Unknown typeKey returns handled error. User without the permission: 403.

title: Admin notification type catalogue: list + toggle company state OFF (NOTIFICATION.ADMIN)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds NOTIFICATION.ADMIN). Type catalogue seeded.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/notification-types; types load with displayName, audiencePermission, severity, companyEnabled.
2. Toggle typeKey LOW_STOCK company state to disabled (enabled=false).
3. Reload — companyEnabled: false.
expected: PUT /api/v1/admin/notifications/types/{typeKey}/state returns 200 NotificationTypeDto. companyEnabled=false. Per-company scope — other companies unaffected. NOTIFICATION.VIEW-only user: 403 on toggle; nav item hidden.

title: Admin delivery log lists + filters by channel and outcome (NOTIFICATION.ADMIN)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Delivery attempts of mixed channel/outcome exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/notification-deliveries; paged delivery log loads.
2. Filter channel=EMAIL → only EMAIL rows.
3. Filter outcome=SUPPRESSED → assert suppressionReason column populated (NO_EMAIL, CHANNEL_DISABLED, COMPANY_TYPE_OFF, MUTED, or NO_AUDIENCE).
expected: GET /api/v1/admin/notifications/deliveries returns 200 + meta. Correct filtered subsets. outcome + suppressionReason visible (answers 'why didn't I get it?'). Empty filter → empty state.

title: Approval policy list for the active company (APPROVALS.POLICY.VIEW)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. At least one policy exists.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/approvals/policies.
2. Read list: name, documentType, branchScope, amount band, status.
expected: GET /api/v1/approvals/policies returns 200 + meta. Paginator present. No raw uid in cells. Amount band formatted. NO-PERMISSION: nav items hidden; forbidden state.

title: Create a COMPANY_WIDE single-step approval policy (APPROVALS.POLICY.MANAGE)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A role code (ACCOUNTANT) exists to use as approverRoleCode.
steps:
1. Click 'New policy'; set documentType=PURCHASE_ORDER, name, branchScope=COMPANY_WIDE.
2. Set minAmount=0, maxAmount=1000000; add 1 step with approverRoleCode=ACCOUNTANT.
3. Submit.
testData: documentType: PURCHASE_ORDER, name: PO <= 1M -> Accountant, minAmount: 0, maxAmount: 1000000, step1 role: ACCOUNTANT
expected: POST /api/v1/approvals/policies returns 201 ApprovalPolicyDto. List reloads with the new ACTIVE policy. Missing name/documentType/minAmount → inline validation, no POST. Empty steps → 'At least one approval step is required'. POLICY.VIEW-only user: 403.

title: Create a BRANCH-scoped policy; branch chosen via picker by name
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Multi-branch company; a non-default ACTIVE branch exists.
steps:
1. New policy; set branchScope=BRANCH; the branch picker appears.
2. Choose the non-default branch BY NAME.
3. Fill documentType and a step; submit.
testData: branch: Mwanza Depot (non-default), documentType: PURCHASE_ORDER, step role: PURCHASE_OFFICER
expected: Policy created with branchScope=BRANCH and branchId set to the picked branch; 201. branchScope=BRANCH with no branch chosen → inline 'Branch UID is required when branch scope is BRANCH'. COMPANY_WIDE with a branchUid → rejected by server.

title: Create a multi-step policy; sequences are dense from 1
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. At least 2 role codes exist.
steps:
1. New policy; add 2 steps (ACCOUNTANT, ORG_ADMIN).
2. Remove the middle step — remaining step resequences to dense 1.
3. Submit.
testData: step1 role: ACCOUNTANT, step2 role: ORG_ADMIN
expected: Policy created with steps in order (sequences dense from 1). Blank approverRoleCode on a step → 'Step N: approver role code is required'. Non-dense sequences are prevented by the UI's resequencing.

title: Create an unbounded top-band policy (maxAmount null)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps: 1. New policy; set minAmount=1000000; leave maxAmount blank; submit.
expected: Policy created with maxAmount=null (top band). List shows '>= 1,000,000' or unbounded indicator. minAmount blank → required error. Negative minAmount → DecimalMin('0') rejection.

title: Edit a policy (saves changes; in-flight PENDING requests are unaffected)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. An ACTIVE policy with a PENDING in-flight request under it.
steps:
1. Open the policy detail by clicking a list row.
2. Change name and a step role; save.
3. Verify the previously-submitted PENDING request is unchanged.
expected: PUT /api/v1/approvals/policies/uid/{uid} returns 200. In-flight request retains its original chain (BR-APR-05 — edits affect only future submissions). POLICY.VIEW-only user: save button hidden / 403 on PUT.

title: Deactivate a policy (ACTIVE → INACTIVE); re-deactivating an inactive policy blocked
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. An ACTIVE policy exists.
steps:
1. On policy detail, click Deactivate.
2. Assert status flips to INACTIVE and Deactivate control is now hidden.
3. Verify the control does not appear when already INACTIVE.
expected: POST /api/v1/approvals/policies/uid/{uid}/deactivate returns 200 with status=INACTIVE. Control is hidden for INACTIVE policies (UI guards illegal transition). User without MANAGE → 403.

title: Approval inbox shows PENDING requests the caller can decide (APPROVALS.DECIDE)
preconditions: ACCOUNTANT logged in (the approver role for the seeded policy step). A PENDING request exists whose current open step routes to ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/approvals/inbox.
2. Read rows: requestNumber, documentType, amount, status badge.
expected: GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/inbox returns 200 + meta. Only requests where caller can decide the current open step appear. NO-DECIDE user → forbidden. Status badge shows PENDING.

title: All-requests list + filter by status (APPROVALS.REQUEST.VIEW)
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in. Requests across multiple statuses exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/approvals/requests.
2. Filter status=PENDING → only PENDING. Then APPROVED. Then REJECTED. Clear → all.
expected: Server filter status=... returns correct subset. Page resets to 0 on filter change. Status badge per row. Company-scoped (only active company's requests).

title: Request detail shows the step chain and current open step
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in. A multi-step PENDING request exists.
steps:
1. Open the request detail from the list row.
2. Read header (requestNumber, documentType, amount, currency, status, submittedBy/At) and steps table.
expected: GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/uid/{uid} returns ApprovalRequestDto incl. steps[]. Current open step = lowest-sequence PENDING. uid in URL only — never as visible text. Amount and dates formatted. Cross-tenant request uid → forbidden.

title: Approve the current open step; single-step → APPROVED; multi-step stays PENDING, advances
preconditions: ACCOUNTANT logged in (current-step approver). A PENDING request on a step routed to ACCOUNTANT.
steps:
1. On request detail, click Approve; add a comment; submit.
2. For single-step: assert status → APPROVED.
3. For multi-step: assert this step → APPROVED; request still PENDING with next step open.
expected: POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/uid/{uid}/approve returns updated ApprovalRequestDto. Correct status per variation. Only the current-step approver may decide (BR-APR-04). Non-approver with APPROVALS.DECIDE but wrong role → service routing denial.

title: Reject the current open step; entire chain killed (later steps → SKIPPED)
preconditions: ACCOUNTANT logged in. A multi-step PENDING request on step 1.
steps:
1. On request detail, click Reject; add comment; submit.
2. Check status of the request and all steps.
expected: POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/uid/{uid}/reject returns status=REJECTED. Step 1 → REJECTED. Remaining steps → SKIPPED. This is terminal — Approve/Reject/Recall controls are hidden. Any further forced API call rejected (BR-APR-07).

title: Recall own PENDING request (submitter-only); non-submitter recall denied
preconditions: Logged in as the SUBMITTER of a PENDING request.
steps:
1. Open the request detail; click Recall (enabled while PENDING).
2. Status → RECALLED.
3. As a different non-admin user, attempt recall of the same request (after restoring state).
expected: POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/uid/{uid}/recall returns status=RECALLED (terminal); 200. Non-submitter (without APPROVALS.ADMIN) recalling → denied by service (submitter-only). Recalling a terminal request: control hidden / service rejects.

title: Admin cancel a non-terminal PENDING request (APPROVALS.ADMIN only)
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in (holds APPROVALS.ADMIN). A PENDING request exists.
steps:
1. Open request detail; Cancel control is enabled for non-terminal requests.
2. Click Cancel → status → CANCELLED.
expected: POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/uid/{uid}/cancel returns status=CANCELLED; 200. APPROVALS.DECIDE-only user: cancel control hidden / 403. Cancel on terminal request (APPROVED/REJECTED/RECALLED/CANCELLED) → control hidden / service rejects.

title: Illegal lifecycle transitions on terminal requests are all blocked
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in. One request in each terminal state: APPROVED, REJECTED, RECALLED, CANCELLED.
steps: For each terminal request: 1. Open detail — confirm Approve/Reject/Recall/Cancel controls are all hidden. 2. Attempt each action via direct API call.
testData: Requests in states: APPROVED, REJECTED, RECALLED, CANCELLED
expected: UI exposes no action on terminal requests. Any forced API call is rejected (BR-APR-07, terminal accepts no further transitions). Detail still renders read-only (C4 idle state).

title: Auto-approved request (no policy matched) shows status=APPROVED + autoApproved flag
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in. Perform a gated action whose amount/scope matches NO policy.
steps:
1. Trigger the action; open the resulting request in /admin/approvals/requests.
2. Read the status and autoApproved field.
testData: Action with amount outside any configured policy band
expected: status=APPROVED, autoApproved=true. The consuming document proceeds. An action matching a policy creates a PENDING chain instead (not auto-approved).

title: Branch-specificity: BRANCH policy beats COMPANY_WIDE when both match
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN logged in. One COMPANY_WIDE and one BRANCH policy for the same documentType/band; the BRANCH policy targets the non-default branch.
steps:
1. Trigger a gated action in the BRANCH-policy's branch within the overlapping band.
2. Open the resulting request; read sourcePolicy.
testData: Overlapping policies; action in the branch-specific branch
expected: sourcePolicy on the request is the BRANCH-scoped policy (branch-specificity wins on a tie, ADR-0022). An action in a different branch (only COMPANY_WIDE matches) uses the COMPANY_WIDE policy.

title: Audit trail lists newest-first, read-only, paginated (AUDIT.VIEW)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds AUDIT.VIEW). Audit rows exist (any login or master action generates them).
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/audit.
2. Read columns: actor username, action, target type, company/branch, time, IP.
3. Confirm there are NO create/edit/delete controls anywhere on the page.
testData: Any active company with audit history
expected: GET /api/v1/audit returns 200 + meta (sorted DESC by time). Rows show actorUsername (not internal id). No write affordance — append-only trail. Paginator present (default page size 50). NO-PERMISSION: nav hidden + forbidden. Page size capped at 200 server-side.

title: Filter audit by actor (chosen via user picker by name)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Actions by at least 2 distinct users exist.
steps:
1. Open the actor filter; select a user BY display name or username from the picker.
2. Apply → only that actor's rows; request carries actorUid=<picked>.
3. Clear filters → full list.
expected: Filtered to chosen actor. The actor uid resolved server-side — never typed by the user. Page resets to 0. Unknown actor uid resolves to no match → empty state.

title: Filter audit by action code, targetType, and date range
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Known audit actions exist.
steps:
1. Set action filter to USER.CREATE.
2. Set from date and to date.
3. Apply → only matching rows.
4. Combine with targetType filter.
expected: Combined AND filter applied. Dates sent as ISO-8601 instants (Z). Blank filters dropped (not sent as null binds). from > to → empty result (not error). Page resets on each filter change.

title: Audit is confined to the caller's active company; rootadmin reads org-wide
preconditions: Two companies A and B with distinct audit rows. Non-root ORG_ADMIN of Company A. rootadmin.
steps:
1. Log in as Company A's non-root ORG_ADMIN → open /admin/audit; read rows.
2. Log out; log in as rootadmin → open /admin/audit.
testData: Company A and B audit rows
expected: Non-root: only Company A's rows returned (AuditReadService scopes to active company). rootadmin: rows across all companies. Company A admin cannot see Company B rows even by setting a Company B targetUid filter.

title: Audit captures platform-domain actions (approvals create/decide/recall, notification type toggle)
preconditions: ORG_ADMIN with AUDIT.VIEW. Perform: create a policy, decide a step, recall a request, toggle a notification type.
steps:
1. Create an approval policy.
2. Decide (approve) an approval step.
3. Recall an approval request.
4. Toggle a notification type state.
5. Filter audit by each action code.
expected: Each action produces an audit row with the correct action code, actor username, target uid, and timestamp. Read-only views (opening a list) do NOT generate audit rows.

title: Audit pagination: page size cap enforced; FIRST/PREV/numbers/NEXT/LAST controls function
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. More than 50 audit rows exist (to span at least 2 pages at default size 50).
steps:
1. Load page 0 (default size 50); click NEXT → page 1.
2. Click LAST; click FIRST; click a numbered page; click PREV.
3. Attempt to request size=300 via URL param.
expected: Correct page slices on each navigation. meta.hasNext drives NEXT button state. Server clamps size to 200 (MAX_PAGE_SIZE) when >200 is requested; size <1 clamps to 1. Paginator self-hides when only one page.

title: No raw uid is visible on a master list (customers)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. At least 3 customers exist.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/customers.
2. Read all visible cell text and all visible labels and action link texts.
testData: Customers: Acme Distributors Ltd (BUSINESS), Jane Walk-in (INDIVIDUAL)
expected: Each row shows display name, type, kind, status badge. No uid string (26-char ULID) is visible in any table cell, label, or action link text. Action links may carry uid in the href path (allowed) but the visible link text must be human ('View Acme Distributors Ltd'), not the uid.

title: uid appears ONLY in the URL path on a detail screen, never in on-screen text
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A confirmed sales order with at least 2 lines exists.
steps:
1. From the SO list, open a row → /admin/sales-orders/uid/<uid>.
2. Capture the page URL.
3. Read all visible detail text: header, customer, lines, totals.
testData: SO number: SO-2026-0007, customer: Acme Distributors Ltd
expected: URL path contains /uid/<uid>. Screen body shows the SO number and customer name — no uid text. Numeric DB id appears nowhere (not in URL, not on screen). Customer is linked as name to /admin/customers/uid/<customerUid> — uid only in the href.

title: Multi-FK form: every resource reference is an app-uid-picker chosen by name (POS sale form)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds POS.SALE.CREATE). One OPEN POS session; at least 2 GOODS products; 1 customer; 1 agent.
steps:
1. Navigate to /admin/pos/sell.
2. For each of: Session, Customer, Agent — assert it is a <select> picker and choose by name.
3. Click 'Add Line'; for the line's Product and Unit, choose by name.
testData: session: Till-1 / 2026-06-14, customer: Jane Walk-in, agent: Internal Rep, product: Widget A, unit: EA
expected: All five references (session, customer, agent, product, unit) are chosen from pickers by human label. No free-text uid input exists for any of them. Submit with no session selected → client formError 'Session is required.', no API call.

title: Large option set in a picker shows the name-filter input box (never a uid box)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. More than 12 GOODS products exist.
steps:
1. Open /admin/pos/sell; click Add Line.
2. Inspect the product picker region.
3. Type a partial name in the filter input.
expected: A filter input with aria-label ending '— filter by name' and placeholder 'Type to filter by name…' appears above the <select>. Typing narrows the option list by label. The bound value remains a uid stored under the hood — the user types only a name fragment, never a uid. With <=12 products the filter box is absent.

title: Non-paginated GET is auto-unwrapped (component sees raw T, not the envelope)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. One customer exists.
steps:
1. Open the customer detail; capture the raw HTTP response body for GET /api/v1/customers/uid/{uid}.
2. Confirm the wire body is { data: {...}, errors: [] }.
3. Confirm the screen rendered the customer fields.
expected: Wire body = envelope with data + errors[]. Component receives the unwrapped data object — no 'data.' prefix leaks into the UI. The apiResponseInterceptor strips the envelope for non-paginated responses.

title: Paginated GET preserves meta {page, size, totalElements, totalPages, hasNext}
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. More than 20 customers (default page size).
steps:
1. Open /admin/customers; capture the raw HTTP response body.
2. Confirm the body has a populated meta field.
3. Confirm the paginator renders using totalPages/hasNext.
testData: 25 customers, size 20 → page 0, totalPages 2, hasNext: true
expected: List request opts out of unwrap (SKIP_UNWRAP); component receives {rows, meta}. meta.totalPages=2, meta.hasNext=true. Paginator shows controls. Empty result: meta.totalElements=0, totalPages=0; paginator self-hides.

title: Error envelope: errors[0] surfaced as inline form error (role=alert)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Open the customer create form; choose partyType BUSINESS; submit without a TIN (triggers a server rule).
2. Capture the response and the on-screen message.
testData: displayName: Bad Biz, partyType: BUSINESS, no TIN
expected: Response: envelope {data:null, errors:['...']}. Component's messageFrom(err) surfaces errors[0] in formError rendered as role='alert'. A 5xx with no errors[] → authErrorInterceptor pops the centered alert. A 403 does NOT pop the modal.

title: Nav hides items the user lacks permission for (by code, not role name)
preconditions: A CUSTOM-role user holding ONLY CUSTOMER.VIEW.
steps:
1. Log in as the custom-role user.
2. Read the rendered nav items.
expected: Only the Customers nav item is visible. POS / GL journals / sales-orders / Users / Roles nav items are absent. rootadmin sees ALL items (isRoot bypass) — positive smoke only.

title: Route guard redirects to /admin/home when permission absent — not a 403 page
preconditions: A user lacking POS.SALE.CREATE.
steps: 1. While logged in, navigate directly to /admin/pos/sell.
expected: The guard returns createUrlTree(['/admin/home']) — the user lands on /admin/home, NOT on a 403 screen. No error modal appears. A user WITH the code reaches /admin/pos/sell normally.

title: API returns 403 for a missing code; UI shows a calm state — no red modal
preconditions: A user with CUSTOMER.VIEW but NOT CUSTOMER.MANAGE.
steps:
1. Open /admin/customers (allowed by VIEW). Confirm the Create button/form is not rendered.
2. Force the POST /api/v1/customers (e.g. replay).
expected: Create button not rendered (canManage computed false). Forced POST returns 403. authErrorInterceptor does NOT show the global red alert for 403 (line 101 of interceptor). Rejection propagates to the component handler (calm state). A 5xx on the same screen DOES pop the centered alert.

title: Loading state on a list shows spinner with aria-live before data arrives
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Intercept GET /api/v1/customers to add 1s latency.
2. Navigate to /admin/customers; assert the loading branch renders before data.
expected: state='loading': spinner rendered with aria-live='polite'. The table is not yet shown. Distinct from the empty and error states.

title: Empty state (idle + 0 rows) is distinct from loading
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A company with no customers (or a search with no matches).
steps: 1. Navigate to /admin/customers with a non-matching search term 'zzzz-no-match'.
expected: isEmpty() true → an explicit 'no customers' empty message, NOT the spinner and NOT an error. Paginator absent (totalPages <= 1). Distinct from the loading state.

title: Error state on server failure shows role=alert; distinct from forbidden
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Intercept GET /api/v1/customers to return 500.
2. Navigate to /admin/customers.
expected: state='error': error message rendered with role='alert'. The centered global alert also fires (5xx path). Distinct from the forbidden state. Paginator absent.

title: Forbidden state on 403 from a list load shows calm message — no red modal
preconditions: A user who can navigate to the screen (holds VIEW) but the data load returns 403.
steps:
1. Intercept the data load to return 403.
2. Navigate to /admin/customers.
expected: state='forbidden': a calm 'no permission' message. The global red alert does NOT fire (interceptor 403 special-case). Distinct from the error state. This is the in-page forbidden state reachable when the user could navigate but the load denies.

title: Full paginator control set renders on a multi-page list with accessibility
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. At least 6 pages of customers (e.g. 120 customers, size 20).
steps:
1. Open /admin/customers (page 0).
2. Inspect the pagination nav.
expected: A <nav aria-label='Customers pagination'> containing: First (aria-label='First page', disabled on page 0), Previous (disabled on page 0), numbered page buttons (windowed ±2 with '...' gap), Next, Last (aria-label='Last page'). Current page has aria-current='page' and is disabled. A visually-hidden aria-live status reads 'Page 1 of 6, 120 items total'. On the last page: Next + Last are disabled; First + Previous are enabled.

title: Paginator self-hides on a single page (totalPages <= 1)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. A company with 3 customers (below the page size).
steps: 1. Open /admin/customers; assert NO pagination nav is rendered.
expected: <app-paginator> renders nothing (@if (meta() && totalPages > 1) is false). No bespoke prev/next buttons exist. Zero rows (totalPages 0) → still hidden.

title: Search/filter resets to page 0 and re-paginates
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Multi-page list.
steps:
1. Navigate to page 3.
2. Type 'Acme' in the search box (300ms debounce).
3. Assert the request fires with page=0 and the filtered query.
expected: Typing pushes {q, page:0}. Results re-paginate from page 0. Paginator recomputes (or self-hides if filtered set is one page). Page resets immediately on filter change.

title: Axe scan is clean on a populated list screen
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. At least 1 page of customers.
steps:
1. Open /admin/customers; wait for idle state.
2. Run an axe accessibility scan.
expected: Zero WCAG 2.1 AA serious/critical violations. Table has a <caption> (visually hidden with sr-only class), every <th> has scope='col', icons are aria-hidden, action links have aria-label. No colour-only information.

title: Axe scan clean on the multi-FK POS sale form
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (POS.SALE.CREATE). An open session and at least 1 product exist.
steps:
1. Open /admin/pos/sell; add one line.
2. Run an axe scan.
testData: Open POS session; one product added
expected: Zero serious/critical violations. Each picker has an associated <label> or aria-label (Session/Customer/Agent/Currency/per-line Product/Unit/Qty). Required markers use aria-hidden asterisks. Line-items table has a <caption> and scope='col' headers. Errors are role='alert'.

title: Keyboard-only operation of paginator and picker
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. Multi-page list; a picker with options.
steps:
1. Tab to the paginator; press Enter on 'Next' → page advances.
2. Tab to an app-uid-picker select; choose an option with arrow keys.
expected: Both controls are fully keyboard-operable (real <button>s and a native <select>). Focus is visible. Selection updates the bound value. No mouse required.

title: Company isolation: Tenant A user cannot see Tenant B's customers
preconditions: Two companies A and B each with distinct customers. A user belonging to Company A only.
steps:
1. Log in as Company A user; open /admin/customers.
2. Read all rows.
testData: Company A customer: A-Customer; Company B customer: B-Customer
expected: Only A-Customer listed. B-Customer never appears. The company selector shows only Company A (hidden when single company). Forcing ?companyId=<B's id> → backend scope check denies (403 or empty).

title: Branch switch changes X-Branch-Uid header and reloads branch-scoped data
preconditions: A user assigned to at least 2 branches. Branch-scoped data differs per branch.
steps:
1. Note the active branch name in the switcher.
2. Open the branch menu; pick another branch BY NAME.
3. Capture a subsequent API call's request headers.
expected: auth.switchBranch(branchUid) updates SessionStore.activeBranchUid. Subsequent requests carry X-Branch-Uid: <new branch uid> (authHeaderInterceptor). Branch-scoped lists reload. Branch selected by name — uid never shown or typed.

title: Acting in an unassigned branch via forged X-Branch-Uid is denied
preconditions: User assigned to branch HQ only. Branch Mwanza exists but user is NOT assigned.
steps: 1. Issue an API call with X-Branch-Uid: <Mwanza uid> while logged in as the HQ-only user.
expected: Backend rejects the request (403 / scope error). The user cannot act in a branch they are not assigned to. The shell switcher never offers Mwanza to this user so the UI cannot reach this state normally.

title: Money rendered as 2-decimal amount paired with currency code; date rendered as ISO yyyy-MM-dd
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. An AR invoice with a non-trivial total (e.g. 1234.5) exists. A POS receipt exists.
steps:
1. Open the AR invoices list; read the rendered amount strings.
2. Open a POS sale receipt; read the total.
3. Open a journal detail; read the posting date.
expected: Amount renders with exactly 2 decimals paired with currency code. Wire value is a string (no floating-point artifacts). POS uses number:'1.2-2' → groups (TZS 1,234.50). AR uses fmtMoney → toFixed(2) → does NOT group (1234.50 TZS). Null amount renders 0.00, never NaN. Date displays as ISO 2026-06-14.

title: Customer archive sets a status (ARCHIVED), not a hard delete; row remains retrievable
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds CUSTOMER.MANAGE). One ACTIVE customer.
steps:
1. Archive the customer from its detail screen.
2. Re-fetch the customer by uid.
expected: PUT /api/v1/customers/uid/{uid}/archive returns 204. Customer still exists on GET /api/v1/customers/uid/{uid} with status=ARCHIVED (muted badge). Not removed from the database. CUSTOMER.VIEW-only: archive button hidden + forced PUT 403.

title: Archived customer can be restored (reversible soft-delete)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. An ARCHIVED customer (from CONV-025).
steps:
1. Restore the customer from its detail screen.
2. Re-fetch the customer.
expected: PUT /api/v1/customers/uid/{uid}/restore returns 204. Status flips back to ACTIVE. Proves soft-delete is reversible. Restoring an already-ACTIVE customer is idempotent or returns a benign 4xx surfaced in errors[0].

title: GL account 'delete' is a deactivate (soft-delete) — not removal
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds GL.MANAGE). One unused ACTIVE GL account.
steps:
1. Trigger the account 'delete' action.
2. Re-fetch the account by uid.
3. Open the journal line account picker and confirm the account is excluded.
expected: DELETE /api/v1/gl/accounts/uid/{uid} calls service.deactivate (returns 204). Account still exists on GET with status=INACTIVE. Not removed. Account is excluded from the journal line picker (inactive filtered out). Existing postings unaffected.

title: Journal is corrected by a reversal entry (append-only); no edit/delete of a posted entry
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN (holds GL.POST). One posted JournalEntry.
steps:
1. Open the posted journal detail.
2. Confirm there is NO edit or delete affordance — only a Reverse action.
3. Reverse the entry (with a reversal date).
4. Check the original entry and the new reversing entry.
expected: POST /api/v1/gl/journals/uid/{uid}/reverse returns 201 with a new JournalEntryDto (debits/credits swapped). Original entry is unchanged and still present. No PUT/DELETE for posted journals. GL.VIEW-only user: reverse returns 403. Reversing an already-reversed entry → server rule rejects (errors[0]).

title: Archived master is hidden from active pickers but visible in an archive filter on the master list
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN. One ARCHIVED customer and several ACTIVE customers.
steps:
1. Open a transaction screen that picks a customer (e.g. POS sale); check if the ARCHIVED customer appears.
2. Open /admin/customers; search or apply status filter; locate the archived customer.
expected: The archived customer does NOT appear in transaction pickers (excluded from active use). It DOES appear in the master list with an ARCHIVED status badge (discoverable for audit). Demonstrates soft-delete preserves history while removing from active use.

title: No raw uid displayed across all IAM screens (companies, branches, users, roles, role-grants)
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Visit each IAM screen in order: /admin/companies, /admin/companies/:companyUid/branches, /admin/users, /admin/users/uid/:uid, /admin/roles, /admin/roles/uid/:uid, /admin/role-grants.
2. On each screen scan all visible text and inputs for uid strings.
expected: uids appear ONLY in URL path segments (/uid/<uid>). Every cross-resource reference is selected via a NAME-bearing select or picker. No <input> accepts a raw uid. Tables/labels show codes/names, never uids. The grant/branch panels show a picker placeholder ('— select —') by name.

title: Axe scan clean across all IAM routes
preconditions: Logged in as ORG_ADMIN.
steps:
1. Load each route and run an axe scan: /login, /admin/companies, /admin/companies/:companyUid/branches, /admin/users, /admin/users/uid/:uid, /admin/roles, /admin/roles/uid/:uid, /admin/role-grants.
2. Tab through forms on each screen.
expected: Zero WCAG 2.1 AA serious/critical violations on each screen. All inputs/selects have labels or aria-labels. Tables have captions and scope='col' headers. Branch and user menus are keyboard-operable. axe passes on the /login page.
